profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Tesla
profile.summary:
MS student in Software Engineering at CMU-SV, who have over 5 years of experience in backend development using different databases and skilled in Cloud Computing, including AWS services, Kubernetes, Terraform, etc. Actively seeking for 2023 full-time SDE.

【Languages】		C/C++, Go, Java, Kotlin, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Scala, Python
【Cloud Computing】	AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Azure, GCP, Apache Spark, Helm, kOps
【Tools & Others】	        Git, Spring Boot, Bootstrap, Node.js, Express.js, Socket.io, MySQL, MongoDB, HBase


My double major in Computer Science and Quantitative Finance had supported me as a multi-disciplinary engineer who has a better understanding of cost and marketing as well as excellent leadership and communication skills with people from different fields.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented image synchronization using Kotlin and Spring Boot with Kubernetes CronJob, and utilized AWS ElastiCache Redis and AWS S3 as storage
- Decreased over 50% of expense by building our own CDN to host the 30,000+ images
- Monitored and diagnosed services by designing 11 alarms with Datadog to send real-time notifications to Slack channel automatically, and created documentation for the company

positions.title: Teaching Assistant (Discrete Mathematics course)
positions.description:
- Interpreted exams and homework solutions in English for a class of 170+ students
- Strengthened students’ classroom knowledge through TA tutoring

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Designed 4 operators (Concat, Shuffle, GroupConv, and ShuffleNet) in C, as a supplement to Open Neural Network Compiler (ONNC), a full-fledged NVIDIA Deep Learning Accelerator (NVDLA) compiler
- Optimized each operator by reducing 50% number of data movement and 83.3% memory usage in average through the movement and placement of data in memory
- Contributed to open-source versions of ONNC, and the optimized versions are for the company’s commercial use

educations.fieldOfStudy: Double majored in Computer Science & Quantitative Finance

- Earned a scholarship of US$830
